cross_cutting_findings: Cargo metadata vs STUDIO_MODULES: only difference is pigment (Cargo allowed includes folio, STUDIO_MODULES depends_on does not); all 14 assigned crates match exactly.
Render plan IR has no allowed owner edge: composite produces it, render-cpu/render-gpu consume it, but there is no composite<->render edge and the renderers have no folio.
Version contradictions: egui 0.33.3 + wgpu 27.0.1 (host lock) vs Craft egui 0.36 + wgpu 30; briefs pin the host versions.

No PSD/PSB/IDML/INDD/AI/FIG fixtures found on the machine (bounded find under D:/Projects/LLM projects maxdepth 6 and Downloads); Adobe/Figma-authored fixtures must be supplied before any parity claim.
